narrative.benchmark_md: VestGen was benchmarked against 5 peers selected for sub-vertical alignment (RIA aggregators), AUM proximity ($3B–$20B), and geographic/competitive relevance. The peer set was locked in research Batch 1 and is immutable for this engagement. Peer scores are category-level estimates derived from public evidence using the same scoring methodology applied to VestGen.
